comment: Seeds the reader-led Phase 1 comparison. `catalyst-comparison.sh run` freezes a secret-free copy into the run directory. Automated checks establish facts; the attached reader review interprets the full evidence without thresholds or an automatic team verdict. The password is referenced by environment variable and never written.
warmupQuestion: How many distinct patients are represented in the readable HIV data?

publish.title: Catalyst Phase 1: three model teams on the locked HIV suite
publish.summary: Catalyst turns plain-English clinical questions into database queries it runs itself. Each team faced the same twelve conversations about an HIV dataset, including follow-up questions, vague requests, and unavailable data. Every database answer is compared with an independently written query for that specific request.
